$comment: Every automated writer that puts content on alpha.school without a person editing WordPress. An agent must consult this before touching any target listed here: a hand edit to a synced target is overwritten on the next run. Sources: #admin-websites and #support-websites history 2025-08 to 2026-09, APEX repo docs (wayfinder-alpha-location-page-publishing-contract.md, wayfinder-alpha-event-publishing-contract.md, wayfinder-current-website-maintenance-topology.md, n8n-staff-source.md, hosted-agent-campus-context.md), public WordPress REST index, growth map API, observer config. Human form: playbook/site/content-pipelines.md.

n8n-campus-pages.name: alpha.school website: Update school pages
n8n-campus-pages.direction: HubSpot Programs -> n8n -> WordPress campus pages (Elementor)
n8n-campus-pages.platform: n8n cloud, trilogyinc.app.n8n.cloud, workflow ORgdHC71YJ5RawBy (folder Alpha School > SEO > Alpha School Website)
n8n-campus-pages.schedule: daily at 00:15 Central (n8n schedule trigger, triggerAtMinute 15); pages show modified 05:18 UTC on 2026-09-16; manual run only under the existing owner/actor and task approval rules; October 7 ownership gap recorded in registry/owners.json
n8n-campus-pages.sourceOfTruth: HubSpot Programs record; HubDB for program-interest mappings
n8n-campus-pages.creates: a draft campus page when Program status is Announced, WordPress Post ID is -1, and the campus is in the workflow's own program-interest allowlist; writes the new post id back to HubSpot

targets.$comment: From the Code node "Update Elementor page content" in the 2026-09-16 export. Key is the Elementor CSS ID (_element_id); value is the field written and its source. A required ID missing from a page makes the run throw for that page.
targets.title: title <- school name + grade levels + "Private School in" city, state (New York: "Serving <grades> Grade in New York City")
targets.content_title: title <- sheet Website Copy Fixed/Dynamic content_title with [CITY], [DISPLAY_REGION], [DISPLAY_NAME*] substitutions
targets.content_body_1: editor <- sheet content_body_1 (New York hardcoded in the flow)
targets.content_body_3: editor <- sheet content_body_3 (New York hardcoded in the flow)
targets.content_body_4: editor <- HubSpot Program website_campus_intro with the same substitutions. THIS IS THE LAUNCH SENTENCE BLOCK.
targets.attend_cta_button: text <- sheet attend_cta_button; link.url #events (optional; the all-items variant hides it)
targets.address: title_text <- grade levels formatted ("K - 8th Grade"; Austin hardcoded "PreK - 5th Grade"); description_text <- school_address; hidden when no address (optional; Raleigh post 6547 excluded)
targets.map: address <- map_location_name + school_address; hidden when no address
targets.phone: description_text <- tel link from contact_number; hidden when empty
targets.cognia_candidate_text: editor <- "<name> is a candidate for accreditation with Cognia"
targets.resource_4: link.url <- admission_link (optional; to be replaced by the Community link concept)
targets.post fields: post_title "SEO - <name>", seo_title, seo_description ("Experience Alpha School's AI-powered, personalized learning at the <city> campus for <grades> grades..."), OpenGraph and X titles and descriptions, JSON-LD School graph (name, url, email, telephone, address, geo, sameAs from Google Maps, Yelp, Niche, GreatSchools, Winnie profiles)

notInScope: hero neighborhood wording (distinct from postal city)
n8n-campus-pages.overrideMechanism: Removing or suffixing a CSS ID (for example address-disabled) stops the workflow from finding the element. Emergency only; record the task, element, temporary value, owner, and restore condition. Pages can also be excluded from the flow by post id (New York was excluded 2025-12).
knownIncidents: 2025-12-10 daily run failed after the events section layout change removed CSS ID events_subtitle; events_top_title and events_subtitle were then dropped from the flow
2026-02-11 Raleigh temporary address protected by renaming the CSS ID
2026-05-21 the flow pushed a wrong description to every location page; fixed next day

2026-09-16 00:18 CT: the run rewrote content_body_4 on all 14 group A pages from website_campus_intro, reverting 12 to "is launching in Fall 2026", Dorado to "launching in Fall 2026 and now accepting applications", Oklahoma City to "is now open"; Greenwich stayed "open and enrolling" because its HubSpot value already says so
n8n-campus-pages.evidenceOfRun: n8n execution log (operators only); HubSpot Post ID change from -1; public page fields match HubSpot
n8n-campus-pages.agentRule: Correct HubSpot first (website_campus_intro through the APEX campus Program editor for the intro block; the onboarding sheet Website Copy tabs for content_title, content_body_1 to 3, attend_cta_button), then run or wait for the 00:15 CT run, then verify. Never hand-edit a listed target as a durable fix.

confirmed2026-09-15.method: find_text_occurrences through the Alpha MCP on the live Atlanta and Plano documents, plus CSS IDs read from the rendered pages
confirmed2026-09-15.result: The intro status sentence ("Alpha <Campus> is open and enrolling." and the "Join us for an info session" paragraph) is the text-editor widget with CSS ID content_body_4. The hero subtitle "<grades> Private School in <City>" is the widget with CSS ID title. Both are n8n-synced. The 14 group A sentence edits of 2026-09-15 therefore last until the next daily run unless the HubSpot website copy (website_campus_intro and the substituted copy blocks) already carries the open wording.
confirmed2026-09-15.liveIds: Plano, Raleigh, Atlanta carry title, address (Raleigh: address-disabled), phone, email, tuition, content_title, content_body_1 to 4, attend_cta_button, cognia_yes, cognia_yes_text, cognia_candidate, cognia_candidate_text, gallery_title, faq_title, team_title, team_top_title, hubspot_events, resource_4

n8n-campus-pages.export: Workflow export supplied by Cristi Constantin 2026-09-16 (36 nodes, active). Read nodes: sub-workflow 6HvmvgkzPkFikc40 "Read programs and their marketing events" (HubSpot), Google Sheet 1gnqy32nKoReaoWKaipxg4UnQlqP916N4xsAsM_HzGoU "School onboarding - single file for all schools" tabs "Website Copy Fixed" (CSS ID -> Value, same for every campus) and "Website Copy Dynamic" (one row per HubSpot Program ID). Write nodes: POST custom/v1/clone-elementor-page (post_id 6140, the SEO Template) and POST custom/v1/update-elementor-page with post_id, seo_title, og_title, x_title, seo_description, og_description, x_description, json_ld, post_title, elementor_data; PATCH crm/v3/objects/p_programs/{id} to write wordpress_post_id after creation. WordPress user: n8n.

n8n-locations-list.name: Locations page List tab
n8n-locations-list.schedule: nightly at midnight Central; on demand
targets: card image (mapped inside n8n, not in HubSpot)
n8n-locations-list.overrides: n8n holds fallback text for campuses with no address and name overrides (Palm Beach shown as West Palm Beach; Alpha Anywhere Center shown as Alpha New York City). Dmitry asked on 2025-11-27 that overrides move into HubSpot data with fixed fallback text.
n8n-locations-list.agentRule: Never edit Locations List cards in Elementor. Data fix goes to HubSpot; display fix goes to the n8n-sync-owner.

hubspot-events-plugin.name: Alpha HubSpot Events plugin stack
hubspot-events-plugin.direction: HubSpot Marketing Events -> WordPress plugin sync -> hubspot_event posts -> /upcoming-events/ and campus event strips
hubspot-events-plugin.platform: three custom WordPress plugins (shortcode/UI layer, HubSpot sync layer, Alpha business-logic layer); REST namespace ahse/v1 with /status and /manual-sync (authenticated); plugin folder seen in a 2025-10 error as wp-content/plugins/Alpha Hubspot Events
hubspot-events-plugin.schedule: automatic sync about every 30 minutes (observed 2026-07), plus manual sync from the WordPress admin
hubspot-events-plugin.sourceOfTruth: HubSpot Marketing Event: public flag (simpleevents_public_event), form program interest, event type, display title, start and end with timezone, registration link (events.alpha.school or Goldcast)
gates: HubSpot private-app connection in the plugin
program interest enabled in plugin settings
internal form program interest value matches the plugin and WordPress term slug (display-name renames do not propagate)
sync range and limit include the event
hubspot-events-plugin.storage: custom post type hubspot_event with taxonomies event_type and program_interest; 29 published and 321 draft records on 2026-08-06; event detail pages at alpha.school/events/<slug>/
hubspot-events-plugin.rendering: Elementor shortcode widget [hubspot_events school="<label>" ...] per campus (container data-has-school=true when scoped); the aggregate /upcoming-events/ is an unscoped query. Global events are events with many program_interest terms, not an event type.
knownIncidents: 2025-11-03 plugin crashing the site, disabled then restored
2026-06 to 2026-09 repeated reports of Public = Yes events not appearing (Southlake, Scottsdale, national activation, San Francisco, Plano) and canceled events staying live
2026-07-13 Park City and La Jolla event strips unscoped (data-has-school=false)
hubspot-events-plugin.agentRule: Never create or edit hubspot_event posts by hand and never flip the HubSpot public flag as a website fix. Diagnose in this order: plugin debug log (absent = mapping branch, present = eligibility or timing branch), then WordPress storage and taxonomies, then the campus shortcode scope. Event owner fixes HubSpot; events-plugin-owner fixes settings or sync; website operator fixes only the shortcode.
hubspot-events-plugin.plannedChange: Hailey proposed on 2026-08-28 to feed the site from APEX events instead of HubSpot Marketing Events, leaving HubSpot only program interest and event type. Not decided.

apex-to-hubspot-events.name: APEX event tracker to HubSpot Marketing Events
apex-to-hubspot-events.direction: APEX -> HubSpot Marketing Event (GET/PATCH marketing/v3/marketing-events/{id}); HubSpot -> APEX read for matching
apex-to-hubspot-events.trigger: manual Push to HubSpot dialog (single or bulk) by an allowlisted user (Hailey McSpadden, Dmitry Bakaev, Farhan Raja, Garbhit Sharma); afterwards automatic re-push whenever url, location, description, date, time, type, program, or status changes on an event already linked by customFields.hubspotMarketingEventId
fieldsWritten: simpleevents_registration_link (from Event.url, itself produced by the Push to Goldcast step)
form_program_interest (first APEX program mapped to the HubSpot enum; this is the campus association the website plugin filters on)
on cancel only: simpleevents_public_event=false and community_app_audience cleared
apex-to-hubspot-events.publicFlag: APEX never sets an event public. simpleevents_public_event is turned on by hand in HubSpot (Hailey). APEX only turns it off on cancellation. The APEX request field eventVisibility/isPublic is not sent to HubSpot.
apex-to-hubspot-events.registration: Push to Goldcast (Hailey only) duplicates a Goldcast template event and stores the registration URL on the event; events.alpha.school register links come from the same field
apex-to-hubspot-events.agentRule: Events originate in APEX. New event content, date changes, or cancellations go to the event owner in APEX; the website follows HubSpot after the plugin sync. A website ticket never edits event data.

growth-map-api.name: Growth map API and map app
growth-map-api.direction: HubSpot Programs -> AWS API Gateway (u7f4afjn6j.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/production/map-locations, CloudFront) -> map.app.alpha.school (S3 and CloudFront, Mapbox) -> iframe on / and /locations/
growth-map-api.agentRule: Read-only mirror of HubSpot for agents without Programs scopes. A wrong pin or label is a HubSpot data fix, or a map app fix if HubSpot is right.
growth-map-api.communityUrlFormats: Two forms observed on 2026-09-17: https://www.community.alpha.school/?campus=<slug> (Short Hills, Jacksonville, The Hamptons) and https://www.community.alpha.school/campuses/prog-<hubspot id> (Indianapolis, Minneapolis, Milwaukee, Columbus, Philadelphia). Confirm with the community app owner which is canonical; the observer check preannouncement-community-url expects the campus parameter form.

hubspot-cms-and-forms.name: HubSpot hosted surfaces and embeds
hubspot-cms-and-forms.direction: HubSpot -> go.alpha.school event landing pages (HubSpot CMS, /alpha-school-event/<id>), HubSpot forms and popups embedded on alpha.school (leadin plugin and hubspot-content-embed), meetings links (meetings.hubspot.com) used as Book a Tour and Book a Call destinations, tracking (js.hs-scripts.com portal 40051392) and consent banner
hubspot-cms-and-forms.agentRule: Form copy, event landing page copy, and meeting links are edited in HubSpot, not WordPress. Event link previews use the HubSpot display title; internal names leak when the display title is blank.

registration-platforms.name: Event registration destinations
registration-platforms.direction: APEX Push to Goldcast (Hailey) creates the registration event -> registration URL stored on the APEX event -> pushed to HubSpot as simpleevents_registration_link -> events.alpha.school/register/<uuid> (Express app on Cloudflare) or alphaschool.registration.goldcast.io
registration-platforms.agentRule: A registration page date that disagrees with the site is a source problem in the registration platform or HubSpot, not a WordPress copy edit.

google-business-profiles.name: Google Business Profile events push
google-business-profiles.direction: HubSpot Marketing Events -> shared Programs/events reader -> n8n Rio SEO create or update events (tq6IV3TeqlBaoWlg_dLkj) -> Google Business Profiles per school
google-business-profiles.agentRule: Not a website surface, but the same HubSpot event data. A public-flag change reaches Google too.

video-library.agentRule: Video catalog changes go to Airtable and re-import; 87 published resources on 2026-08-06.

other-writers.name: Other authenticated write paths into Elementor
list: alpha-mcp/v1 (Alpha WordPress MCP 0.3.0): the playbook path; field-scoped, snapshot and receipt

custom/v1/update-elementor-page and clone-elementor-page: the n8n campus-page workflow's write path (confirmed in the 2026-09-16 export; clone uses the SEO Template post 6140), also called by the APEX hosted worker for campus intro, phone, and program edits. No published schema; WordPress user "n8n"

apex-elementor/v1/pages/{id} GET and POST {revision, source}: guarded Elementor save used by the APEX hosted worker; apex-elementor/v1/event-filter GET and POST sets the events plugin program-interest filter option ahse_program_interest_filter, with Playwright verification at 1440 and 390 px
wp/v2/media POST: APEX hosted worker staff headshot uploads and alt text
elementor/v1/cache DELETE and wpe/cache-plugin/v1/clear_all_caches POST: APEX cache purge with its own ALPHA_CACHE credentials
mcp/emcp-tools-server and apex-emcp-compat/v1: Elementor MCP tools server (export-page, batch-update) used by the older APEX hosted worker path, with a heading-compatibility shim
wp-abilities/v1 and mcp/mcp-adapter-default-server: WordPress core abilities API and MCP adapter

APEX hosted agent runs on a GitHub Actions schedule every 5 minutes (2-57/5) when HOSTED_AGENT_ENABLED and HOSTED_AGENT_PRODUCTION_ENABLED are set; live edits need HOSTED_AGENT_LIVE_EDITS=true plus per-capability flags and pilot task lists
other-writers.agentRule: Two agents can hold work on the same page: the APEX hosted agent (5-minute schedule, exclusive web:alpha.school lease inside APEX) and this playbook agent through the Alpha MCP. Compare the semantic hash before applying, purge and verify afterward, and record the APEX ticket on every MCP apply so the two audit trails meet.

apex-to-hubspot-programs.name: APEX campus Program editor to HubSpot Programs
apex-to-hubspot-programs.direction: APEX -> HubSpot Programs custom object 2-43470849 (PATCH crm/v3/objects/2-43470849/{programId}); HubSpot -> APEX every 30 minutes (cron campus-hubspot-sync into CampusMapping and CampusPacketProfile.hubspotSnapshot)
apex-to-hubspot-programs.platform: APEX app: src/lib/hubspot-program-write.ts, campus-program-sync.ts, website-handoff-source.ts; hosted agent routes api/agent/tasks/{id}/campus-program and campus-intro
apex-to-hubspot-programs.trigger: human review and approval of a program change in APEX; hosted agent behind HOSTED_AGENT_CAMPUS_PROGRAM_ENABLED and HOSTED_AGENT_CAMPUS_INTRO_ENABLED with a live claim and the web:alpha.school lease
apex-to-hubspot-programs.gate: HUBSPOT_PROGRAM_WRITE_TOKEN, no fallback; optimistic concurrency against the last snapshot; read-back verification; wordpress_post_id mismatch is a hard conflict
apex-to-hubspot-programs.agentRule: This is the sanctioned way to change a campus fact: APEX program change -> HubSpot -> n8n -> page. The playbook agent does not write HubSpot itself; it files or advances the APEX program change and verifies the page after the n8n run. The 30-minute HubSpot-to-APEX import is also a readable mirror of Programs for agents that lack HubSpot scopes.

rio-seo-locations.name: Rio SEO Locations Data Push
rio-seo-locations.direction: Shared HubSpot Programs/events reader -> n8n giviJTDi7Q3uM4HM -> Rio location listing import
rio-seo-locations.agentRule: Validate final rendered fields. A failed execution can have already submitted valid rows; inspect import acceptance and completion before retry. Source-reader recovery is separate from this consumer.
